messages.subject: Re: Sequenza demo
messages.body_plain:
Dear Sabra,

For our own analysis, we always uses FALCON-X and don’t have a readily available script for Sequenza. They seem to have fairly detailed documentation though https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/sequenza/vignettes/sequenza.html

Yuchao

> On Apr 8, 2020, at 7:39 PM, Sabra Djomehri <sdjo...@stanford.edu> wrote:
>
> Dear Yuchao,
>   I hope this message finds you well. I’m looking on your Canopy instruction page, for Sequenza demo R script, but couldn’t find it (I saw the Falcon demo R script). If possible could you please send it to me? It would be very helpful and I’m looking forward to running Canopy from my Sequenza segments output.
>
> Best,
> Sabra
